text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival... 
It's here, it's finally come—the day of my 
demise...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I doubt "Let's play sports together and 
sweat away the past!" will fly with her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The way I acted at the Kinko Sho... If a 
former fan confronts me about it, I'll 
turn into a shooting star..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? But in a way, it's also 
an opportunity, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I want to apologize. 
Just so they'll let me quietly exist in 
some corner of the Umamusume world.

"And at the meet-and-greet talk show after 
all events concluded. When Matikane 
Fukukitaru took the stage..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
H-H-How should we take this commotion? I 
suppose it's better than angry shouting, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru-san, could you tell us 
about your goals for the spring?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gack?! Y-You're bringing that up right off 
the bat?! Well, my spring goal is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sitting quietly on the veranda, munching 
on rice crackers while sipping tea. 
*sluuuuurp*...

text_block_list.name: Female Host
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. So—what's your real goal?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
She shows no mercy at all, does she?! 
Um... Trainer?
choice_data_list: Why don't you try saying it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you out of your mind?! Are you 
really serious?! Uuugh, don't blame me if 
anything happens...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, my goal for this spring is! No, 
rather than a goal, my dream is—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeek, you actually said it, you said 
it, you said it~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa, please don't throw things! Keep 
the premises clean~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Applause? W-Why?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, do your best! 
Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming to cheer for you! You'd better 
race, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why, everyone? Even after I ran such a 
lazy, shameful race at the Kinko Sho...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I laughed at that. It was awful. 
But... somehow, you just couldn't bring 
yourself to hate it.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There are times when you just get carried 
away, like, 'I've totally got this!' I 
guess I kind of felt a kinship with that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A sense of closeness? Then you haven't... 
abandoned me yet...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up on you. You showed me how 
hard you could try back at the Kikuka Sho, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Through thick and thin, we're in this 
together. You've gotta run in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, okay? I'll definitely 
vote for you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone... Everyone! Are you gods? Are 
you buddhas? How could you be so 
merciful...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The tears, the sweat, all sorts 
of fluids won't stop flowing! How could 
this... How could this beee~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes...! I'll give it one more try.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just like back then, desperately clawing 
my way up the cliffside while praying for 
good luck.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I am so sorry for how I acted 
back then. I had completely lost sight of 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As penance to keep doing my best from now 
on, I'll do 108 squats! So please cut me 
some slack~

A warm, chuckling laugh fills the venue. 
Afterwards, Matikane Fukukitaru somehow 
manages to earn the right to enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to return to my roots and start 
over from scratch. I might still have a 
long way to go, but please watch over me!

"When one door closes, a fan opens 
another. Afterward, Matikane Fukukitaru 
somehow managed to secure a spot in the 
Takarazuka Kinen."
